verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean centred axis and the original order, but the dark header band floats with an odd cream strip above it. The orange rule has moved from under the headline to under the eyebrow, and there are big dead gaps between the headline, the body copy and the CTA. B also floats the header band, and it moves the eyebrow into the band, which changes the brand header. Its headline is centred while the body copy and the 'Reserve a Case' button shift left onto a different axis, so the left edge is ragged and nothing reads as aligned. It has the same large empty gaps, and its legal text is microscopic.
